# PackageLevelInterconnectOptimization

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
Co-optimization of package substrate routing and die placement to minimize global interconnect delay and congestion. Essential for TCC's chiplet-based topologies where package-level links dominate performance.
